content: A majority of the previous literature combine the word and character-level contexts by simply concatenating the word and character embeddings at each decoding step, e.g. INLINEFORM0 in Eq. SECREF4 . However, this naive concatenation of two modalities (word and characters) results in inaccurate decoding, specifically for unknown word token embeddings (an all-zero vector INLINEFORM1 or a random vector INLINEFORM2 is assigned for any unknown token INLINEFORM3 , thus INLINEFORM4 or INLINEFORM5 ). While this concatenation approach does not cause significant errors for well-formatted text, we observe that it induces performance degradation for our social media post datasets which contain a significant number of missing tokens.
